concepts.list: Create a realistic production-quality Windows desktop app UI design for 新境 XINJING, a gaming and everyday Windows utility. Design the SYSTEM OPTIMIZATION page, not the tools page or hardware page. EXACT target 1487 x 1058 pixels. Match the proportions and actual visual design of both attached product reference images. Preserve sunny pastel blue fantasy anime floating castle waterfalls lake wallpaper, white-haired traveler and cat bottom left, mint geometric 新境 brand, pale blue-white frosted glass, thin white borders, restrained shadows, 16-22px corner radii, navy ink Chinese labels, muted blue-gray secondary text, mint #a2f2df and teal #20c9a6 accents. Keep wallpaper visible in margins and between sections. Same floating dock at x17 y26 w92 h653, brand at top, labels 首页 / 游戏库 / 硬件 / 工具 / 优化 / 音乐, only 优化 selected mint with rocket icon. Same top global search x208 y27 width424 height48 with 搜索游戏、工具或功能… and Ctrl K. Same avatar/theme shirt icon and minimize/maximize/close controls top right. Main content starts x208, right edge1468. At y110 header 系统优化 (36-38px), small 演示内容 pill. Subtitle 按需调整，让系统更合心意。 Date 2026年10月24日 星期六, anchored October24 2026 Saturday in Asia/Shanghai. MiSans-like Chinese sans, 20-24px section headings, 14-16px readable body, Font Awesome-like standard icons, no emoji. Strong hierarchy, spacious precise alignment, no cramped tiny font. One independent complete app screen, no collage, device bezel, mockup presentation board, option number or concept name printed in UI. No dark theme, industrial cyber dashboard, large purple backgrounds, or UI style drift. No made-up health/performance score, no estimated FPS gains, no fake scan results, no applied-success notifications, no fake recovery-point records. All machine values unknown until detection: show 当前状态未检测 / 未检测; do not assert the user's actual Windows version or administrator state. A small Windows配置预览 caption is fine. This is design only; not executable system actions. Checkboxes represent STAGED choices, never already-applied states. Distinguish 选择目标 and 应用状态; primary action reviews selected changes before applying. Recovery is 查看修改记录 or 管理恢复记录, never promise universal one-click full rollback. Do not show C drive paths, system installers, cache deletion controls or tools from separate tools tab. Do not include disabling Defender, firewall, security mitigations, updates, pagefile, or virtualization as recommended tweaks. Keep technical registry/command details out of the main page. Do not make the entire app one giant centered card. Use grouping, whitespace and simple dividers first. Do not box every list row; consistent glass surfaces for groups are allowed as references. Use exact coherent Chinese, no clipped controls. Direction named 分类调优台. Focused settings-selection layout. Header right at y210 two quiet glass buttons 检测当前配置 with refresh icon and 修改记录 with history icon. Toolbar y235-284: search 搜索优化设置… at x208 width330, then category pills 常用设置 / 桌面与交互 selected mint / 游戏与图形 / 更多. Main below y310: left settings glass surface width850 and right narrower pending-change pane width390, gap20. Left heading 桌面与交互 with subtitle 按需选择设置，应用前查看变更。 Six rows with light separators, about82px tall: 显示文件扩展名 (checked mint, description 更容易识别文件类型, target 显示); 显示隐藏项目 (unchecked, description 按需查看隐藏文件, target 显示); 减少窗口动画 (checked mint, description 减少窗口切换动态效果, target 减少); 关闭透明效果 (unchecked, description 使用更纯净的窗口底色, target 关闭); 隐藏任务栏小组件 (unchecked, description 精简任务栏入口, target 隐藏); 调整菜单显示延迟 (unchecked, description 调整菜单弹出的等待时间, target 200 ms). Each row has standard little icon, bold title and description, subtle 当前：未检测 and a compact target-value control; selection checkbox must be distinct from current-state text. Only two checked rows. Show no on/off switches that imply immediate changes. Top right of settings group small 6项设置, reflecting six visible rows, no invented entire registry count. Right pane 待应用 2项, two simple rows matching checked names 显示文件扩展名 and 减少窗口动画; readable target values; concise 未应用. Primary mint button 查看待应用, quiet 清空选择 link. Below separator 修改记录, empty line 尚未进行任何修改。, 查看记录 link. Small footer 可先检测当前配置，再按需选择。 No red warnings or fake success. End content near y935, leave lower lake visible.
